simple.meaning: קֵדְמָה (Qêdᵉmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Kedemah , a son of Ishmael.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֵדְמָה (H6929) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:15, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֵדְמָה (H6929) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֵדְמָה (H6929) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֵדְמָה (Qêdᵉmâh) / H6929 is traced through Genesis 25:15, 1 Chronicles 1:31 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
